headline: The first corrected calibration channel finished all 44 paired trials. The remaining-channel array is progressing on Ruche.
restart_description: Channel 0 (job 2014220) archived all 44 pairs: 43 completed normally and one numerical failure was retained. Its exit 2 deliberately reports that method failure, not an archive error. Array 2014222 is now running channel 1; channels 2–7 are queued.
